# AgentSight

> AgentSight is an open-source, local-first profiler that connects AI agent intent and model activity to commands, processes, files, network destinations, and resource use.

Canonical site: https://agentsight.us/
Current verified release: v0.2.67
Product repository: https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight
Website repository: https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight-website
Documentation: https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight#readme
Recorded demo: https://app.agentsight.us/

## Evidence policy

Pages distinguish observed effects, attribution, inference, and unavailable data. Public claims are checked against the current release and primary sources. A missing event is not proof that an effect was impossible.

## Data handling

Recorded sessions can contain prompts, responses, paths, headers, commands, and network targets. Treat raw databases and exports as sensitive. Keep raw data local, redact review artifacts, and publish only the minimum evidence required for a decision.
